import json, os, tempfile
from log import save_log
recs = [{"a": 1}, {"t": "caf\u00e9"}, {"t": "a\u2028b"}, {}]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = os.path.join(d, "r.jsonl")
    save_log(p, recs)
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
text = data.decode("utf-8")
lines = text.split("\n")
assert lines[-1] == "", ("not terminated by \\n", text[-20:])
lines = lines[:-1]
assert len(lines) == len(recs), ("not one document per line", len(lines), len(recs))
for line, rec in zip(lines, recs):
    assert "\r" not in line, ("a line ends in \\r", line)
    assert json.loads(line) == rec, (line, rec)

import json


def save_log(path, events):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("".join(json.dumps(e, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n" for e in events))


def load_log(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f.read().splitlines()]
